# EACTS/STS/AATS Guidelines: Temporary Mechanical Circulatory Support (tMCS) in Cardiac Surgery

Early tMCS Is Now a Class I Recommendation for Cardiogenic Shock
[ Learn More ][63]

### The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has determined Impella is safe and effective for its
### intended uses.
* **1,500+**
  
  Peer reviewed clinical studies have published on Impella, including DanGer Shock RCT published in
  the New England Journal of Medicine
* **17**
  
  Clinical Guidelines and Consensus statements
* **400,000+**
  
  Patients have been treated with Impella heart pumps

[For Interventional Cardiologists]

## For Interventional Cardiologists

Treat high-risk PCI, cardiogenic shock and right heart failure patients

[ Learn More ][64]
[For Cardiac and Vascular Surgeons]

## For Cardiac and Vascular Surgeons

Escalate, stabilize and recover native organs with minimally-invasive surgical techniques

[ Learn More ][65]
[For Nurses]

## For Nurses

Use calculators, watch quick skills videos and learn patient management best practices

[ Explore Resources ][66]
[For Fellows]

## For Fellows

Advance your knowledge and develop skills to treat complex PCI patients

[ Explore Resources ][67]

## For Referring Providers

Are you caring for patients with heart disease? Learn more about how Impella heart pumps work, the
benefits of Protected PCI with Impella and explore patient identification resources. 

[ Learn More ][68]

## Native Heart and Lung Recovery

### Conditions & Therapies

Access education, clinical evidence and practice support for Protected PCI, AMI cardiogenic shock,
right heart failure, surgical applications and severe lung failure.

[ Learn More ][69]

### Products & Services

Learn about the latest technology and how that technology may best support your patient.

[ Learn More ][70]

### Education & Resources

Abiomed provides a comprehensive training program for health care providers.

[ Learn More ][71]

## Subscribe to receive the latest clinical data and priority access to resources.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

day and everywhere.

lasting value for the communities we serve.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## CardioNerds Healy Honor Roll

The **CardioNerds Healy Honor Roll** is the list of cardiovascular fellowship programs which support
the CardioNerds mission to **Democratize Cardiovascular Education**. Each honor roll program
nominates a CardioNerds Ambassador & contributes open-access content by way of CardioNerds Case
Reports Series.

**CardioNerds Ambassadors** are fellows nominated by CardioNerds fellowships to represent education
at their program.

The CardioNerds Healy Honor Roll is named after [**Dr. Bernadine Patricia Healy**][118], a
CardioNerd Hero who was the first female director of the National Institutes of Health and
accomplished incredible achievements during her career.

## CardioNerds Academy

The **CardioNerds Academy **was founded in January of 2021 to further the democratization of
cardiovascular education and to create digital content for asynchronous medical education with the
overarching mission of marrying content creation with personal and professional development. 

The Academy harnesses the entire CardioNerds network and platform to facilitate mentorship,
networking, and collaborative efforts at the national and international level.

CardioNerds academy fellows are divided into 4 equal **“Houses of Cards” **that are named after
cardiology legends, [**Vivien Thomas, Helen Taussig, Edith Jones, and Willem Einthoven**][123]**.**

[ [CardioNerds Houses 2022] ][124]

## CardioNerds Academy

The **CardioNerds Academy **was founded in January of 2021 to further the democratization of
cardiovascular education and to create digital content for asynchronous medical education with the
overarching mission of marrying content creation with personal and professional development. 

The Academy harnesses the entire CardioNerds network and platform to facilitate mentorship,
networking, and collaborative efforts at the national and international level.

CardioNerds academy fellows are divided into 4 equal **“Houses of Cards” **that are named after
cardiology legends, [**Vivien Thomas, Helen Taussig, Edith Jones, and Willem Einthoven**][123]**.**

# [Vitalstream by Caretaker Medical]

You can't manage what you can't see.

One device for both non-invasive & a-line continuous hemodynamic monitoring.

VitalStream is built to prevent complications before they start, across every point of care, from
pre-op through discharge.

[ Schedule a Demo ][19]
[ How it Works ][20]

### Trusted by 150+ Clinical Customers

[Row rect Shape]
[Vitalstream Wearable on wrist]

## ICU-Level Precision.
## No Longer Confined to the ICU.

For decades, continuous beat-by-beat monitoring was only available through invasive arterial lines
in the most critical care settings — leaving millions of patients in dangerous blind spots.

VitalStream sets a new standard. Whether invasively or non-invasively, our multi-modal device
delivers continuous hemodynamic intelligence wherever the patient is, so every clinician has what
they need to catch decompensation early and treat with confidence.

Until now, there were only two options: accept the blind spots that put patients at risk, or accept
the invasive lines that slow their recovery. Either way, the patient paid the price.

That tradeoff ends here.

[ Schedule a Demo ][21]

## What a Blind Spot Costs

A patient’s blood pressure reads as stable, but their Cardiac Output is silently declining.

You won’t realize until they crash, and you’re left managing a crisis instead of preventing one.

The delayed intervention, misread fluid status, or data that arrived too late can lead to longer ICU
stays, higher complication rates, and the increase the downstream costs of reactive care.

Now, multiply this across 50 million surgeries and 5 million ICU admissions, and the results could
cost the healthcare system billions every year.

VitalStream's validated accuracy changes that equation. By integrating **multimodal arterial line
connectivity with our continuous noninvasive monitoring**, you can see the "why" behind the vitals.
You can act earlier, with precision, and prevent the complications that turn routine recoveries into
extended ICU stays.

Behind every preventable deterioration is a moment of inadequate data. VitalStream is built to
eliminate that moment.

[ Schedule a Demo ][22]

*AKI: Acute Kidney Injury. MINS: Myocardial Injury After Non Cardiac Surgery

72%

of non cardiac surgery patients experienced a hypotensive event

27%

of patients have one or more missed hypotensive event with intermittent monitoring

[divider]

maximum potential cost per year resulting from AKI or MINS

## One Device. Every Modality.

VitalStream ART delivers continuous, beat-to-beat hemodynamic data — invasively and non-invasively —
through a single platform that moves with your patient from the moment they enter the hospital to
the moment they leave.

[VitalStream Wearable with dock]
* **Invasive & non-invasive monitoring in one platform**
* **Works with any invasive arterial line **— no proprietary transducer required
* **Superior 10-day sensor life** — non-invasive sensors last for the entire patient stay
* **Beat-to-beat accuracy **validated across 20 peer-reviewed studies
* **Continuous streaming data** — no manual charting
* **Wire-free mobility** — no care gaps, 24/7 access to patient vitals
* **Integrates with GE Carescape and Philips Intellivue**
* **Operational in under 90 seconds** — no complex setup required.

We aren't just a monitor; we are a complication-avoidance platform.

## The VitalStream Patient Journey

One device. The same hemodynamic record. From admission to discharge.

[step 1]

#### Pre-Op

Monitoring begins before the patient enters the OR — wirelessly, noninvasively, with no arterial
line required. Abnormalities caught here don't become emergencies in the OR.

[StepLine 1]
[step 2]

#### OR & ICU

Continuous intraoperative monitoring for moderate-risk patients, non-invasively. For high-acuity
needs, dock into the ART-Dock to leverage existing arterial line signals — no specialized
transducers. Fluid management decisions are made on evidence, not estimation.

[StepLine 1]
[step 3]

#### Step-Down & Discharge

Undock. The wearable returns to mobile use, maintaining a continuous data stream through transport
and ambulation. The data stream doesn't stop because the setting changes. Neither does the
protection.

[Dr. Rali photo]

through a single platform that moves with your patient from the moment they enter the hospital to
the moment they leave.

- Aniket Rali, MD,

For decades, continuous beat-by-beat monitoring was only available through invasive arterial lines
in the most critical care settings — leaving millions of patients in dangerous blind spots.

delivers continuous hemodynamic intelligence wherever the patient is, so every clinician has what
they need to catch decompensation early and treat with confidence.

Until now, there were only two options: accept the blind spots that put patients at risk, or accept
the invasive lines that slow their recovery. Either way, the patient paid the price.

That tradeoff ends here.

[ Schedule a Demo ][21]

## What a Blind Spot Costs

A patient’s blood pressure reads as stable, but their Cardiac Output is silently declining.

You won’t realize until they crash, and you’re left managing a crisis instead of preventing one.

The delayed intervention, misread fluid status, or data that arrived too late can lead to longer ICU
stays, higher complication rates, and the increase the downstream costs of reactive care.

Now, multiply this across 50 million surgeries and 5 million ICU admissions, and the results could
cost the healthcare system billions every year.

VitalStream's validated accuracy changes that equation. By integrating **multimodal arterial line
connectivity with our continuous noninvasive monitoring**, you can see the "why" behind the vitals.
You can act earlier, with precision, and prevent the complications that turn routine recoveries into
extended ICU stays.

Behind every preventable deterioration is a moment of inadequate data. VitalStream is built to
eliminate that moment.

HeartPlace & Fort Worth Heart join forces to expand access to the highest standards of care in Texas

HeartPlace and Fort Worth Heart have partnered to expand our footprint of high-quality,
patient-centered cardiovascular care to more communities across DFW. Our collaboration is a
significant step in our commitment to extend your access to the highest standards of care in Texas,
utilizing:
* World-class clinical expertise and research
* Leading-edge technology and facilities for the prevention, early detection, and treatment of
  cardiovascular disease, including PET/CT imaging systems and state-of-the-art Ambulatory Surgery
  Centers
* New patient-centered programs, like 24/7 triage care, remote monitoring and chronic care
  management, that ensure quality care between appointments

By expanding our family westward, we now offer outpatient care in the following locations:
* Downtown Fort Worth-Medical District, 1900 Mistletoe Blvd., Fort Worth, TX 76104
* SW Fort Worth-Mira Vista, 6949 Bryant Irvin, Fort Worth, TX 76132

# Heartplace

## Cardiologists & Vascular Specialists located in Dallas Fort Worth and the North Texas Region

HeartPlace is the largest physician-owned cardiology group in North Texas, with cardiovascular
disease and cardiac electrophysiology specialists who consistently appear on ***D Magazine*** and
***Texas Monthly***'s “Top Doctors” lists. The practice has several clinics convenient to you under
the **HeartPlace** and **Fort Worth Heart brand** names across the region, serving patients in
Allen, Keller, Arlington, Fort Worth, Dallas, Plano, Corsicana, Garland, Glen Rose, Granbury,
Bedford, Burleson, Irving, Mansfield, Mesquite, Richardson, North Richland Hills, Red Oak, and
Stephenville.

The multidisciplinary HeartPlace and Fort Worth Heart teams aim to improve and protect the heart and
vascular health of all their patients in these North Texas communities. Their cardiovascular disease
specialists deliver the highest quality of care for a comprehensive range of cardiac and circulatory
diseases, including [heart disease][95], [arrhythmia][96], [carotid artery disease][97], [peripheral
vascular disease][98], [hypertension][99], [high cholesterol][100], and venous conditions. 

HeartPlace has sophisticated cardiac imaging and other diagnostic technologies onsite so patients
have fast, easy access to duplex ultrasound, [echocardiography][101], electrocardiography, [nuclear
stress testing][102], and portable event and Holter monitoring. HeartPlace also offers convenient
mobile check-in for consultations.

In addition to their diagnostic services, HeartPlace provides an equally impressive selection of
treatments, including endovenous chemical thermal ablation, alcohol septal ablation, implantable
defibrillators, pacemakers, and LVADs (left ventricular assist devices), as well as minimally
invasive catheterization procedures such as atherectomy, balloon angioplasty and stenting, and
thrombolysis. 

HeartPlace’s skilled surgeons also perform advanced cardiothoracic surgeries, including cardiac
bypass, ASD (atrial septal defect) and PFO (patent foramen ovale) closure for holes in the heart,
and off-pump cardiac surgery.

Patients at HeartPlace receive a warm welcome and professional treatment delivered with compassion
and consideration at every office. To arrange your visit, call your closest HeartPlace location
today.

defibrillators, pacemakers, and LVADs (left ventricular assist devices), as well as minimally
invasive catheterization procedures such as atherectomy, balloon angioplasty and stenting, and
thrombolysis. 

HeartPlace’s skilled surgeons also perform advanced cardiothoracic surgeries, including cardiac
bypass, ASD (atrial septal defect) and PFO (patent foramen ovale) closure for holes in the heart,
and off-pump cardiac surgery.

Patients at HeartPlace receive a warm welcome and professional treatment delivered with compassion
and consideration at every office. To arrange your visit, call your closest HeartPlace location
today.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Why choose Ochsner?

At Ochsner, we lead the way in comprehensive healthcare, combining innovation, expertise and
exceptional service, with you at the heart of everything we do.

### A history of care, innovation and trust since 1942

Since 1942, Ochsner Health has served as a trusted leader in healthcare. While much has changed over
the decades, our commitment to patient care remains the same. Every treatment we administer, every
innovation we pioneer and every partnership we build is for one reason: you.

Ochsner is committed to improving the health and wellness of our community by increasing access to
care, educating the next generation, creating economic opportunities, and partnering with other
mission-driven organizations.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Open Heart

is an open access journal by BMJ and BCS, publishing original research in cardiovascular medicine.

**Impact Factor: 3.1****
Citescore: 4.3**
[All metrics >>][38]

Open Heart is dedicated to publishing high quality, peer reviewed medical research in all
disciplines and therapeutic areas of cardiovascular medicine. Research is published across all study
phases and designs, from protocols to phase I trials to meta-analyses, including small or specialist
studies. Opinionated discussions on controversial topics are welcomed.

Open Heart is the open access companion to [Heart][39] and is an official journal of the [ British
Cardiovascular Society][40].

Follow the journal via [X, ][41][Facebook][42] and [LinkedIn][43].

Open Heart considers submissions of a variety of article types, including original research
articles, study protocols and occasional review articles. Responses to published work are also
welcomed.

Information is also provided on [editorial policies][47] and [open access][48].

This is an open access journal that levies an Article Publishing Charge (APC). Discounts and waivers
are available; details are provided in the Author Information section.

All manuscripts should be submitted online.

New Jersey, and beyond.

[[Old illustration of the exterior of the Pennsylvania Hospital Pine Building]][13]

][15]

maternity care—is a living symbol of innovation.

][26]

candidates.

][29]

about 30 percent less likely to develop breast cancer.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**
